title: Shahi Paneer
subtitle: Paneer cubes in a rich tomato, cashew and malai gravy — quick, creamy and restaurant-style.
protein: ~13–15g protein per adult serving — from paneer

method.title: Prep the pastes
items: Soak {@cashews} and {@melon-seeds} in hot water for at least 30 min
Drain and grind them to a fine, smooth paste with a little water; keep aside
Wash {@tomatoes} and blend to a puree; keep aside
Cut {@paneer} into big cubes; keep aside

method.title: Build the gravy
items: Heat {@ghee} in a kadai; add {@bay-leaf}, crushed {@black-cardamom}, {@green-cardamom}, {@cumin} and {@hing}
When the cumin splutters, add the tomato puree; sauté until oil releases from the sides
Add {@ginger-paste} and the nut paste; stir-fry 2–3 min
Add {@turmeric}, {@salt} and {@kasuri-methi:masala} — methi at this stage infuses a lovely aroma
Bhuno the masala 5 min, until it's really cooked and oil shows at the sides
Add {@malai:gravy}; cook until it's absorbed into the gravy

method.label: Toddler — pull her portion here (before any chili)
items: Scoop {=3–4 tbsp} of the gravy into a small pan
Loosen with a splash of water; simmer 2 min until the paneer is soft

method.title: Spice, simmer and finish
items: Add {@kashmiri-chili}, {@chili-powder} and {@green-chili} to the adult pan; sauté 1–2 min
Add {@paneer:main|the remaining paneer} and {@garam-masala}; mix with a light hand so every piece is coated
Add {@water}; cook 5 min, until oil releases at the sides again
Transfer to a serving bowl; garnish with {@malai:garnish|a drizzle of cream} and {@kasuri-methi:garnish|the rest of the kasuri methi}
Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently with a splash of water

method.label: Tip
method.text: The chilies now go in after the gravy is cooked (the original added them with the tomato), so the toddler's portion can come out first. Ginger-green chili paste was split: ginger goes in the gravy, the chili in the adult finish. Frozen paneer: soak the cubes in hot water 30 min first — it makes them creamier. No Kashmiri chili? A pinch of red food colour gives the same colour. For a richer gravy, use up to 2 tbsp cashews, and be generous with the ghee for that restaurant taste.
